<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def find_dot():
    a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n'); R=len(a);C=len(a[0]); g=[list(r) for r in a]
    for r in range(R):
        for c in range(C):
            if g[r][c]=='r' and any(0<=r+dr<R and 0<=c+dc<C and g[r+dr][c+dc]=='N' for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))):
                return (r,c)
    return None
def blocks():
    d={}
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('O','S','Y','N') and 3<n['pixels']<80 and n['boundary'][0][0]<52:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            d[n['color']]=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    return d
for i in range(8):
    res=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':57,'col':12}])
    b=blocks(); d=find_dot()
    print("orange-right",i+1,"N",b.get('N'),"dot",d,"lvl",res.get('level_completed'))
    if res.get('level_completed'): break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def find_dot():
    a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n'); R=len(a);C=len(a[0]); g=[list(r) for r in a]
    for r in range(R):
        for c in range(C):
            if g[r][c]=='r' and any(0<=r+dr<R and 0<=c+dc<C and g[r+dr][c+dc]=='N' for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))):
                return (r,c)
    return None
def blocks():
    d={}
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('O','S','Y','N') and 3<n['pixels']<80 and n['boundary'][0][0]<52:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            d[n['color']]=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    return d
for i in range(8):
    res=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':57,'col':12}])
    b=blocks(); d=find_dot()
    print("orange-right",i+1,"N",b.get('N'),"dot",d,"lvl",res.get('level_completed'))
    if res.get('level_completed'): break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
